gpu: Apple M5 Pro integrated GPU, 20 cores, Metal 4
memory_method: Sum of RSS for ollama serve and llama-server, sampled every 0.1 seconds; background after confirmed unload
gpu_memory_method: Separate peak GPU memory unavailable; Ollama /api/ps size_vram retained as model placement estimate
